name: Kanban Draft Vault
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
The retention limits dialog no longer applies a limit of 1 and removes saved drafts.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Apply limits with an empty field now asks for a number instead of deleting saved drafts.
tip: Run Open draft recovery to find text kept from a new-card form closed with Escape or a click outside.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Kanban Draft Vault is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your card drafts safe.
